name: TIGRE DRR Generation
definition: A technique to prepare 2D X-ray images from collected CT volumes to create paired datasets for training, overcoming the impracticality of collecting paired clinical data.
summary: TIGRE DRR Generation converts 3D CT volumes into 2D radiographs by simulating X-ray projection, differing from standard volume rendering by explicitly targeting X-ray attenuation physics for medical imaging.
